headline: Recommended paying a $281.27 tire claim and denying a $250.00 pothole claim.
summary: The committee recommended paying Ashley Mazzucco $281.27 for a tire claim. It recommended denying Christine King's $250.00 pothole claim and referring it to the water supply board. Branden Dyson's pothole claim was recommended for indefinite postponement, and William Samos withdrew his pothole claim.
decisions: Recommended payment of Ashley Mazzucco's $281.27 tire claim, 3-0.
Recommended denial of Christine King's $250.00 pothole claim and referral to the water supply board, 3-0.
Recommended indefinite postponement of Branden Dyson's pothole claim, pending estimates, 3-0.
William Samos withdrew his pothole claim, pending estimates, at the claimant's request.

PAWTUCKET CITY COUNCIL 
COMMITTEE ON CLAIMS AND PENDING SUITS 
August 5, 2026 
 
A meeting of the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits was held Wednesday, August 5, 2026, 
at 6:15 p.m., in the Temporary City Council Office, Room 204, 2nd Floor, 100 Freight St., 
Pawtucket, RI.   
 
Present – Councilor Rubio, Chair; Councilors Araujo and Moreno. 
 
Absent – 0. 
 
Councilor Rubio presided.  
 
Also present were Chris Crawley, Acting Director of Public Works; and Frank J. Milos, Jr., Esq., 
City Solicitor. 
 
The Committee conducted a public input period, at which there were no speakers. 
 
 
 
 
 
RECOMMENDED TO BE PAID, AS FOLLOWS:

NOES — 0. 
 
Ashley Mazzucco – $281.27 (Tire)

Pawtucket City Council
